rows.text:
Agent review, contributor migration (round 7):
- Supply provenance when filtering browser-local federation nodes and edges.
- Reference repository-owned edges without claiming their ownership.
- Publish lifecycle value constraints in component/property data models.
- Acquire partial graphs and their provenance root from one consistent service snapshot.
Corrections and regression coverage are in progress; this checkpoint is not approved yet.
